title: How the market works
summary: Three catalog levels: featured quests, moderated releases and demos for a quick look.

shots.title: Featured comes first
shots.caption: At the top of the shelf are quests the team picked by hand. These are finished games and the best place to start.

shots.title: Levels open gradually
shots.caption: The higher the level, the more you need to play and rate before it opens. Start with featured quests: everyone can play them.

shots.title: Demos are for a quick look
shots.caption: Demo quests are short and show what the editor can do. They stay out of the main feed and do not compete with full games.
